headline: Global Investors Captivated by BI's Moves, Foreign Capital Inflows Reach Rp130,96 T
summary: Total net foreign capital inflow into Indonesia reached Rp130.96 trillion as of 23 November 2026. Investors were drawn by Bank Indonesia's policy approach, according to the source.
why: Foreign portfolio flows into Indonesian stocks and bonds affect the rupiah and market liquidity. Bank Indonesia is the country's central bank, setting interest rates and managing the currency.
original_headline: Investor Global Kepincut Jurus BI, Aliran Modal Asing Masuk Rp130,96 T
